title: Hyunchang Kweon
text: Hi! I'm Hyunchang Kweon, and I also go by Thomas. I'm currently studying aerospace engineering at Seoul National University and have been admitted to Purdue University for a master's degree in aerospace engineering. My interests include safe control and data-driven learning for aerial platforms.
